confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: Darling, what a charming little theory. Archibald was with me the whole time. Weren't you, Archibald?

confession.speaker: archibald
confession.text: I... was on the telephone, old girl.

confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: Traitor! Very well! Two hundred pounds a year? After twenty years of his snoring? He was signing the new will at ten o'clock!

confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: So at seventeen minutes past nine I picked up the nearest heavy object. It happened to be solid silver. BONK!

confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: I locked the door behind me, burned that wretched letter and popped the key in the coal scuttle. Nobody looks in a coal scuttle!

confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: I'd have got clean away with it, too, if it weren't for a gardener lurking in the hall and a butler with ears like an elephant!

confession.speaker: victoria
confession.text: ...Does anyone have smelling salts? I feel a swoon coming on.

recap.speaker: narrator
recap.text: Case closed! At 21:17, in the library, Lady Victoria Blackwood struck her husband down with the silver candlestick Reginald had lit and set on his desk only five minutes before.

recap.speaker: narrator
recap.text: The motive was the new will. Signed at ten the next morning, it would have left her two hundred pounds a year, and the solicitor's letter she burned in the dining-room fire said so, charred but still readable.

recap.speaker: narrator
recap.text: She locked the library from outside and hid its only key in the dining-room coal scuttle. The room she swore she had never left was exactly where the key and the letter turned up.

recap.speaker: narrator
recap.text: Her alibi was Archibald, and his alibi was her. But Archibald was on the servants' telephone, as Reginald heard from his pantry, and Gregory, dripping in the hall alcove where he left that muddy footprint, saw her lock the door by the light of a lightning flash.

recap.speaker: narrator
recap.text: Reginald has some explaining to do about the household accounts, Archibald about the company's, and Gregory about the gin. But none of them is a murderer.

reginald.speaker: reginald
reginald.text: Me, sir? Murder? I have never so much as bent a fork!

reginald.speaker: reginald
reginald.text: Thirty years in service, sir, and not a spoon out of place. I shall see to the tea while you think again.

archibald.speaker: archibald
archibald.text: Preposterous! Absolutely preposterous! Yes, I threatened him, but I threaten everybody! It's how I say good morning!

archibald.speaker: archibald
archibald.text: My solicitors will hear of this, sir! Every last one of them! First thing in the morning!

gregory.speaker: gregory
gregory.text: M-me, sir? I never! I only came in out of the rain, honest I did!

gregory.speaker: gregory
gregory.text: Beggin' your pardon, sir, I'll just go and stand in the kitchen till somebody believes me.

victoria.speaker: victoria
victoria.text: Me? Oh, detective. Accusing a grieving widow in her own hall. How terribly modern of you.

victoria.speaker: victoria
victoria.text: Do run along and find whoever did this to poor Edmund, darling. I shall be in the hall, being brave.

sloppyRemark.speaker: narrator
sloppyRemark.text: Case closed, detective, though a few of those exhibits had no business in the evidence bag.
